instruction.title: Assembly of a metal rod with sleeves
instruction.description: An instructional video showing step by step how to assemble a metal rod with various sleeves, O-rings and screws, as well as how to glue, clean and lubricate it.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.notes: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator places a long metal rod on the workbench.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.notes:
The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod.

The copper sleeve should be facing to the right.

It is important to have six copper sleeves, as well as 5 long sleeves (the longest ones we have). Start and finish with copper sleeves.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator slides a combination of long, short and copper sleeves onto the rod.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.notes: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator places O-rings in the holes on the rod and adjusts the sleeves over them.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.notes: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator drives the screws halfway into all holes using a power screwdriver.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.notes: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator applies threadlocker (Loctite) to all partially inserted screws.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.notes:
The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves.

Here it is important that the screw is not screwed in too far: all the way into the sleeve, but not so far that it sticks out.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator fully tightens all screws to secure the sleeves.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.notes:
The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper.

Do not polish the copper part.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator cleans the rod and sleeves with ethanol and paper.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.notes: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves, while avoiding the copper sleeves.
steps.subtitle_text: The operator applies grease to a sponge and lubricates the silver-colored sleeves, while avoiding the copper sleeves.
